title: SugarCraft — SugarMCPClient
description: SugarMCPClient: MCP client core — JSON-RPC 2.0 codec, stdio transport with bounded child lifecycle, initialize/tools handshake, deny-before-allow server narrowing (tool rosters follow servers). Extracted from candy-code; first-party.
ogDescription: One faithful Model Context Protocol client core for the whole ecosystem: a JSON-RPC 2.0 envelope codec, a newline-framed stdio transport with a bounded child lifecycle, the initialize/tools handshake, and deny-before-allow server narrowing — tool rosters follow servers.
tagline: MCP client core — JSON-RPC codec, stdio transport, server narrowing
